title: Fix manufacturing enum fallback in item journals
summary: Manufacturing enum fallback logic in item journals now correctly returns false when Manufacturing subscribers are absent, preventing ordinary records from being misclassified as manufacturing records.
key_points: Adds Boolean predicate events for manufacturing classification instead of relying on enum getters that return ordinal zero when subscribers are absent
Applies fixes across salesperson dimensions, journal line setup, item tracking validation, recurring journal selection, and the Inventory Posting - Test report
Preserves existing getter APIs while introducing new predicate events for classification
Propagates changes to all eight country-specific layers
Includes new regression tests for production and non-production scenarios
quote: Avoid classifying ordinary item journal lines and templates as manufacturing records when optional Manufacturing enum-getter subscribers are absent.
